svg.title: Employee net pay and other payroll-liability settlement
svg.desc: Employee net pay and other payroll-liability settlement. A register creates accrued net pay and other payroll liabilities. Employee payment and liability remittance settle separate branches; register and settlement records connect to the ledger. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
